title: Official India curriculum source registry, rights and founder file-inbox contract
baseCommit: 4a7df340 (KAN-187 VMM-19 head; composes VMM-03 rights + VMM-02 digest fabric)
whatBuilt: CURRICULUM SOURCE REGISTRY: versioned, rights-aware catalog — state/UT, board (CBSE/CISCE/NIOS/NCERT/state), class/grade, stream, medium, language, subject, academic year, chapter/topics, edition/publisher/book ID, download ref; every source carries {license, consentRef, rightsStatus} where rightsStatus ∈ {pending, approved, denied, withdrawn}
RIGHTS-AWARE: only APPROVED sources are ingest-eligible; rights transitions (pending -> approved -> withdrawn) enforced; unapproved sources refused at the inbox gate
NO PARALLEL DATABASE: the registry defines the CURRICULUM TAXONOMY + RIGHTS layer over the existing source contract (KAN-29/60-65/144); content bytes stay in the existing source store

FOUNDER FILE-INBOX MANIFEST: the founder drops textbook files into an approved private folder; the manifest validates each file against a registered APPROVED source with a matching SHA-256; sealed by the founder only; sealed manifests refuse new files
INGEST ELIGIBILITY CHECK: confirms all sources approved before KAN-209 runs; unapproved source ids reported
Invalid taxonomy values, missing rights, duplicate source ids, empty files all fail closed
